posts.title: A second look to Multer DOS
posts.description: For context check an old post To keep things short, I’ve been doing some software archeology on my pasts projects. I noticed that my opensourced project https://github.com/Daniel-M/multer-dos was getting about 10 downloads a week on the npm registry https://www.npmjs.com/package/multer-dos so i decided to add support for typescript and dependency updates. The project is so easy to maintain, I guess part of the 10 downloads per week means this is still used in production by some people, so thanks for believing in me
